༄༅/ /rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ma hā kā lā aṣ+ṭa s+ya u pa de sha sarba tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud ces bya ba/ dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon byon khrag 'thung khros pa he ru kas// dur khrod 'bar ba 'og min gnas mchog tu// bdud dang mu stegs tshogs rnams drag pos bsgral// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir dregs pa'i tshogs// dbang bsdus tshar bcad rjes su bzung ba'i tshe// rang rang srog snying 'bru rgyus phul ba'i dus// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa'i gnyer kha gtad// dam chos skyong ba'i srung mar dbang bskur te// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa rab gyur pa// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ gleng bzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o/// / ༈ /de nas khrag 'thung 'bar ba he ru kas// dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la 'di gsungs so| |thog mar dur khrod la sogs gnas dben par// stegs bu'i steng du khrag gis chag chag btab// lha gnas de bzhin dkyil 'khor rab bris la| |'bru nag ba ling mchod pa'i yo byad bshams// sgrub po lhor blta he ru kar bskyed de// mdun du mgon po mched brgyad yum dang bcas// las mkhan bka' sdod tshogs rnams gsal bar bskyed// spyan drangs gnyis med bstims shing mchod cing bstod// bsnyen sgrub dag la ma yeng 'bad nas bsgrub// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ lha sgrub pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas dbang gi rim pa bskur ba ni// dam tshig thos bsam sgom la rab brtson zhing*// lam mkhan mchog ston zhi dul lung gis phyug /dbang gi las mkhas ngang ring 'jam zhing dal// dam tshig ldan pa rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// thos chung nga rgyal che la lam ston rmugs// rgyud thung dam bral khro la lung gis dben// dbang ma mkhas pa'i slob dpon spang bar bya// brtson ldan rgyud 'jam shes ldan blo yangs drang*// dam srung bla ma'i bka' sgrub tshig 'jam smra| |'di 'dra bla ma mkhas pa'i slob mar 'os// brtson bral rgyud rtsub shes chung blo dog la// g.yo rgyu che zhing dam nyams bka' mi bsgrub// tshig rtsub gdams pa rku la gzhogs slong byed| |rang che 'gying la slob dpon sba zhing gsang*// de 'dra'i slob ma spangs shing bskrad byar 'os// tshul ldan bla ma skal ldan slob ma rnams// dbang mchog bskur thabs dben par dkyil 'khor bya// mchod gtor yo byad 'du bya bdag 'jug blangs// slob ma gral 'god khrus bya bgegs rnams bskrad// maṇ+ḍal dbul la gsol gdab bdun dag bya// sdom bzung gdong bcings dam bzhag ye shes dbab// me tog dor zhing ming gdags dkyil 'khor bstan// bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes dang*// tshig dbang ming gi dbang bskur dag pa brjod// slar yang gtor ma so so'i dbang bzhi bskur// bzlas pa'i lung bya dam bzhag gtang rag gi

/maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gshegs bsdu bsngo smon bya| |las kyi mjug bsdu mi mngon gsang bar bya// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ dbang gi le'u ste gsum pa'o/// / ༈ /da ni srung zlog bsad sreg mnan pa'i las// gtso bo'i rtsa sngags 'bru thos las sngags la// rak+ṣa'i 'dogs can bsrung ba'i sham bu dang*// bh+yo zlog sgyur sogs drag po'i zlog sngags mjug /bsad par ma rā ya rā dza sod rbad// sreg na khā hi dz+wa la raṃ sogs dang*// mnan na s+t+waṃ bha ya nan sogs sbyar// 'gugs na aṅku sha dzaḥmajug tu gdags// dngos grub len tshe sarba sid+dhi'i mjug /spro bsdu'i dmigs pas bdag gzhan bsrung ba dang*// zlog bsad sreg dang mnan pa 'di bzhi po// drag po'i las kyi mtha' sdud mchog yin no// rdo rje nag po mched brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ srung zlog bsad mnan gyi kha bsgyur ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/// / ༈ /las mtha'i man ngag phan thabs gnod bya gnyis// thog mar phan thabs sde brgyad spyi srung dang*| |yams srung 'brum pa srung dang srin bu srung*// cham srung mdze nad srung dang gag pa srung*// lhog pa srung dang par+pa ta srung dang*// gza' nad srung dang thog gi srung ba dang*// ser ba srung dang chu bo zlog pa dang*// lus stobs bskyed dang rkun jag 'ching ba dang*// g.yul rgyal ba dang gcan gzan kha 'ching dang*// mtshon srung ba dang phan thabs bco brgyad do// gnod byed klu gtad sa bdag spyi gtad dang*/ /mnan pa 'gong chog skrod pa than 'gyed dang*// jag 'ching zhing sel khang sel nor sel dang*// dur sel thog 'bebs ser 'bebs sad 'beb dang*| |zas sbyor mdze 'byung smyo byed rlung zhon dang*// klad srin zlog pa gtong dang sha rul dang*// hur sod 'brug gtad rnams te nyer gsum mo// kun la mgon brgyad bsnyen pa thems pa gces// rang rang las res don re 'grub par 'gyur// rdo rje nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/

phan gnod kyi las phran bu'i skor gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas slar yang yang dag bshad bya ba// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mtha' bstan pa ni// gro ga 'am shog bu dag la liṅga bris/ */ ming rus dbus bri sngags kyis mtha' nas bskor// rdzas byugs brub khung nang du dril la gzhug /dgug cing gzhug par thun brab sngags la 'bad// lha dbye dus drug skam gsher thun yang brab// bsad rtags rdzogs nas liṅga me la bsreg /thal sol lha srin 'gyu sar mnan gtad bya// des ni dgra rnams bdun rgyud 'chad par byed// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ bsad pa'i las bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas sngags kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// thog mar kun gyi rtsa ba bsnyen sngags ni// 'bum phrag gcig ni deng sang bsnyen pa'i tshad// gzhi nas lha 'grub de srid bsnyen tshad rdzogs// lha ma 'grub tshe bsnyen tshad thems ma yin// phreng ba rus pa rak+sha dag gi 'am// bo dhi rtsi ni mchog gi phreng ba gsum// las 'di'i phreng bar 'os pa rnam gsum yin// bzlas brjod byed tshe mi dal mi myur zhing*// sgra cher mi bsgrags ha cang chung ba'ang min// gug 'greng klad skor ma nyams zur ma chag /ring thung snyoms shing grangs nges don ma nor// mtshams su mi smra yeng stabs ma yin par// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ngang nas bzlas brjod bya// sgra grags thams cad bzlas pa'i sngags su bsam// 'di ltar byas na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ sngags bzla ba'i rnam dag gi le'u ste bdun pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas rjes shes bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni// dus gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad dang*// rig pa'i ye shes lhan skyes he ru kaḥ /gdod nas dag pa mgon po brgyad yin yang*// de nyid ma rtogs lha dang rang rig gnyis// tha dad gzung 'dzin 'khor bar rtag tu 'khyams// kye ma/

rang rig ye shes rjen gsal rnyog pa bral// brjod 'das yul rkyen bral zhing ngo bos stong*// mnyam yang lta byed rtogs mkhan rig pa'i mdangs// kun byed rgyal po stong gsal ye nas dag /lha yang de yin bsgrub bya sgrub byed bral// mchod bstod dbyer med mgon po logs su med// rang rig mthong na chos skyong 'grub par 'gyur// ye nas rang rig ye shes zhi bar gnas// chos skyong sgrub tshe de nyid lhag par lhong*// de la rtsol byas bral ba'i brtson 'grus dang*// bzang ngan re dogs bral ba'i rtogs pa mchog /'khor ba'i chos nyid dag dang ma dag pa// du mar snang yang ngor gcig nyid du 'char// rjen gsal chos kyi sku nyid 'grub par 'gyur// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/ rjes shes kyi rnal 'byor pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/// / ༈ /de yi mjug don yongs su gtad pa ni// rgyud 'di ye shes mgon po thams cad kyi// man ngag bsdus te bshad pa'i phyir yin pas// shin tu gnyan pas gsang zhing sba bar bya// dam med slob ma'i lag tu shor ra re// dam ldan bu la tshang bar sbyin la mchod// rgyud 'di me 'dra thog 'dra don med min// skal ldan thar par 'khrid cing bde ba 'thob| |skal med rnams la don 'di dgos mi 'gyur// dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i spu gri yin// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa'i srung ma 'di// chos skyong mgon po mched brgyad las med phyir// srung mar bskos pa'i mthu rtsal 'di la yod// de phyir rgyal ba rnams kyis 'di bsngags so// rgyud 'di mgon po rang rang thams cad kyi// rgyud dang man ngag zab pa kun bsdus nas// phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'di la mtshan don ni// rdo rje nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi// man ngag thams cad yongs su bsdus pa yi// rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes byar gzung bar bya// rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud las/

mjug don yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// rdo rje nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi spyi rgyud chen po le'u dgu pa rdzogs so/// /rgyud 'di ni 'gyur snga phyi kun dang mthun no// zhes pa'i rgyud chen po 'di mgon po'i rgyud las legs par btus te/ man ngag zab pa rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dir bsdebs te tshig don yang rgyud rang sor bzhag pa la/ dgos pa'i tshig mtshams sbyor phran bus brgyan te dge slong dharma kīrtis bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
